method: Deterministic native SVG text diagrams rendered from a separate Leviticus chapter-companion catalog.

source_review.plan_path_policy: Reviewed chapter plans remain private and are not copied into repository outputs.
source_review.active_ranges: Each chapter is partitioned into ordered, disjoint source ranges covering every local KJV verse exactly once.
source_review.anchors: Every unit anchor is a single verse inside the unit's active range.
source_review.card_copy: The plan summary is stored separately from the full note and is used for SVG card text.

visual_style.applied: Ivory background, forest-green connectors, muted sage cards, and a left-column reading flow.

source_review.detail_scope: Optional Art references are passed through only when their repository asset exists; the text diagram itself makes no claim to depict the detail or whole passage.

scripture_source.translation: KJV as stored in the local corpus

scope: Twenty-seven editorial chapter diagrams partition all 859 Leviticus verses into source-based reading units. They are chapter outlines, not a single scene or map.

interaction_coordinates.y: The pin and focus share the card-center y coordinate.
